title: MultiTenantFormSubmissionResponse
description: Response for a multi-tenant form submission

formSubmissionId.description: Unique identifier of the canonical form submission record

status.description: Aggregated status across all tenants: success, partial_success, or failed

gcsUploadStarted.description: Reserved for GCS document upload dispatch. Always false in this release; will reflect actual Cloud Task dispatch in a follow-up PR.

TenantSubmissionResult.description: Result of processing a single tenant in a multi-tenant form submission

tenantId.description: The tenant ID that was processed

status.description: Processing status for this tenant: success or failed

certifyId.description: Tenant crosswalk certify ID, populated when a tenant crosswalk was created. Empty string when only a portal crosswalk was created.

errorCode.description: Error code when status is failed

errorMessage.description: Human-readable error detail when status is failed
